description: This file defines Cucumber hooks to manage the lifecycle of WebDriver in automated UI testing. It contains methods annotated with @Before and @After to set up and tear down WebDriver instances around test scenarios.

classes.name: Hooks
classes.description: Contains Cucumber hooks for initializing and cleaning up WebDriver before and after scenarios.

methods.name: beforeScenario
methods.description: Initializes WebDriver and logs the start of a scenario.

methods.name: afterScenario
methods.description: Logs the completion status of a scenario and quits WebDriver.
